description:
Leidos currently has an opening for a Data Engineer at its Picatinny Arsenal, NJ location to develop unique software integration design solutions and analytical models to collect and analyze in-process inspection data in a production relevant environment for propulsion materials, develop custom design solutions, integrating data types, hardware, and software, and provide research, development, and production engineering support within the Propulsion Division, DEVCOM Armaments Center, Picatinny Arsenal, NJ..   
   
 Primary Responsibilitie 
 Design, build, and maintain the software and data infrastructure responsible for capturing, processing, and analyzing high-volume inspection data directly from production lines. 
 Bridge the gap between in-process hardware/sensors (ie cameras, optical inspection sensors/lasers, PLCs, torque/dimension gauges) and analytics/dashboards, ensuring real-time quality control and defect detection. 
 Design and develop reliable, low-latency software applications and microservices to ingest data from production-line sensors, cameras, test stands, and PLCs. 
 Build edge-to-cloud or edge-to-on-premise data pipelines that handle high-frequency inspection streams without dropping data or lagging production cycles. 
 Implement real-time and batch-processing logic to flag out-of-spec tolerances, statistical process control (SPC) anomalies, or defect clusters immediately. 
 Architect scalable storage solutions (time-series databases, relational DBs, or industrial data lakes) to store historical inspection records for traceability and root-cause analysis. 
 ·         Partner with Quality Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and Data Scientists to turn process-control rules and machine-learning models into live production software. 
 ·         Build internal dashboards, APIs, or alerting mechanisms for shop-floor operators and quality managers. 
   
 Basic Qualifications 

 Minimum bachelor’s degree in engineering field; Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Engineering preferred; Industrial Engineering, Automation Engineering, Robotics Engineering / Mechatronics or other disciplines with relevant experience considered on a case-by-case basis 
 Ability to work in a combination of office and pilot scale manufacturing environment for hazardous materials settings, with travel to project sites estimated 25 - 30% of the time. 
 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer, ideally in a manufacturing, industrial automation, or hardware-interfacing environment. 
 Proven experience writing production software to interface with hardware, sensors, or machinery. 
 Programming: Strong proficiency in Python (preferred for data/backend services) and/or C++ / C# (for edge/hardware integration). 
 Protocols & Streaming: Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus) and message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ). 
 Databases: Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and time-series or high-throughput storage. 
 Data Processing: Experience with modern pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow) and data transformation frameworks. 
 Quality & DevOps: Git, Docker/containerization, CI/CD, and writing automated tests. 
 US Citizenship required 
   
 Preferred Qualifications. 
 None
